verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for a commerce and payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows infrastructure for external, third-party agents: the MCP server, Link CLI, agent skills, SPTs and ACS integrations. None of it documents an AI assistant built into the product that users can delegate tasks to, so these are building blocks for other agents rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
